title: Design: long and special tier names in the work order toasts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Tier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingTierPlanX).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Have three new customers for this test, customers A, B and C, on tiers A, B and C for work orders, each with a new work order with one labor line.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's work order.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Open customer B's work order.
  9. Click Add Part under line 1.
  10. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  11. Type 1 in Qty.
  12. Pick category A in Category.
  13. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  14. Click Save.
  15. Open customer C's work order.
  16. Click Add Part under line 1.
  17. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  18. Type 1 in Qty.
  19. Pick category A in Category.
  20. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  21. Click Save.
